steps.label: Progressive delivery
steps.sub: wires the advance/abort decision into real metric queries

code:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata:
  name: error-rate-check
spec:
  metrics:
    - name: error-rate
      interval: 1m
      successCondition: result[0] <= 0.01
      failureLimit: 2
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus.monitoring:9090
          query: |
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="checkout",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
            /
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="checkout"}[5m]))
caption: Same PromQL from the observability course — now driving a deployment decision, not just a panel.

code:
strategy:
  canary:
    steps:
      - setWeight: 10
      - analysis:
          templates:
            - templateName: error-rate-check
      - setWeight: 50
      - analysis:
          templates:
            - templateName: error-rate-check
      - setWeight: 100
caption: A breach aborts the rollout and shifts traffic back to stable — no human paged first.
